code='''def transform(grid):
    # Full separator rows/columns divide the board into small panels.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]

    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rows, cols = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)
    # The two non-background colors are the panel dividers and the marks.
    background = min(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    # Mark color is the remaining value distinct from background and separator.
    marks = [v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v != background and v != sep]

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    values = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    candidates = [v for v in values
                  if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid)
                  and any(all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)) for c in range(w))]
    sep = candidates[0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == sep for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            out.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        out.append((start, n))
        return out
    rows, cols = spans(h, sep_rows), spans(w, sep_cols)
    remaining = [v for v in values if v != sep]
    background = max(remaining, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    mark = next(v for v in remaining if v != background)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2 else background
             for c0, c1 in cols] for r0, r1 in rows]
'''
